name: ST-VQA: Scene Text Visual Question Answering Benchmark
description: ST-VQA (Scene Text Visual Question Answering) is a benchmark dataset requiring models to recognize, read, and comprehend scene text in natural images to answer questions, comprising 31,791 question-answer pairs on 23,038 images across multiple source datasets.

publisher.name: Computer Vision Center (CVC), Autonomous University of Barcelona

license.name: Academic Research Use
license.notes: Provided for research and competition purposes under ICDAR Robust Reading Competition terms. No explicit open-source or commercial license is granted by the competition organizers.

source_references.title: ST-VQA Challenge Portal
source_references.notes: Official ICDAR Robust Reading Competition site.

verification.notes: Verified against ICCV 2019 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICCV.2019.00439) and ICDAR RRC challenge metadata. License status verified as unspecified_by_source in accordance with competition terms. Exactly 31,791 QA pairs (26,308 train, 5,483 test) across 23,038 natural scene images from 6 source datasets.

size.notes: Natural scene images and JSON QA annotations.
